## Overview

Dabigatran is described in the supplied source as a new oral direct thrombin inhibitor ([src_8a669b066c4cb002e5224ef48c9a8550](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_8a669b066c4cb002e5224ef48c9a8550.md)). Unlike the factor Xa inhibitors in this corpus, its mechanism of action is direct thrombin inhibition.

## Dosing studied in atrial fibrillation

Fixed doses of 110 mg or 150 mg twice daily were compared with unblinded adjusted-dose [warfarin](./warfarin.md) in 18,113 patients with atrial fibrillation and a risk of stroke; median follow-up was 2.0 years ([src_8a669b066c4cb002e5224ef48c9a8550](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_8a669b066c4cb002e5224ef48c9a8550.md)).
